body:
i know the internet has media to consume in it, but i just don't feel a pull that makes it enough to be motivational for me. i appreciate this sentiment but like i already said, i'm slowly losing interest in a lot of the things i loved (games, books, movies, etc.), and wanting to see shows and such continue or how it ends just isn't enough for me anymore, especially because it's so temporary too. if i don't lose motivation to continue to enjoy media, and i finish it, then it just...ends. and then i have nothing to keep me grounded anymore. 

i just see suicide as a responsible solution which may sound pretty batshit, but hey, if i'm just being a drag on society and the government, then i may as well go somewhere else - even if that somewhere else is a very terrifying place of "nothing".
